import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
public class Main {
    static Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
    static PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
        pw.flush();
    }
    public static void solve() {
        int t = sc.nextInt();
        while(t-- > 0) {
            int n = sc.nextInt();
            int[] a = new int[n];
            for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i] = sc.nextInt();
            }
            int k = sc.nextInt();
            Arrays.sort(a);
            int ma = 1, cnt = 1;
            for(int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
                for(int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                    if(a[j] - a[i] <= k) {
                        cnt++;
                    } else {
                        ma = Math.max(ma, cnt);
                        cnt = 1;
                    }
                }
                ma = Math.max(ma, cnt);
                cnt = 1;
            }
            pw.println(Math.max(ma, cnt));
        }
    }
}
